provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: Some areas of the backyard fence used for outdoor play were below the required minimum 4 feet high.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §747.4105)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Lumber with protruding nails was stacked at the backyard with no barrier to make it  inaccessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained: Sign-in and sign-out records for children in care were not available.    This was corrected at inspection with the caregiver entering in the children's arrival times. The caregiver stated that she will continue to sign-in and out children daily as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Logs Maintained (26 TAC §747.635(a))

occurrences.finding: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility: The combination carbon monoxide/smoke detector was not mounted or working in the living room area where the children spend the day indoors for lessons, play, meals and nap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Registered or Licensed Child-Care Home Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System, unless located in a School Facility (26 TAC §747.5331)

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 1 child's immunization exemption was not notarized, as required, in order to be valid.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §747.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Children under 5yo who were playing at the front porch and carport area were not within complete visual awareness of the caregiver, as the caregiver was inside changing a diaper with the front door open. The ages of the children present required increased supervision, due to lack of the required fenced outdoor space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §747.1503(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space: 4 children under 5yo were observed playing outside along the front porch and carport. The front yard did not have the required fenced yard as required for children under 5 years of age.    This was corrected at inspection with the caregiver being notified of the requirement, and the caregiver then moving the children to the fenced backyard for outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §747.4105)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: The TV was on while children were playing. The content on the TV was a cartoon not connected to an educational goal.    This was corrected at inspection with discussion on the standard with the caregiver and the caregiver turning the TV off during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §747.2105(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Children's records did not have all required information per standard 747.605.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 4 children in care did not have a health statement on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §747.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: Operational policies did not include notification of parent's rights, and the caregiver stated that she had not notified parents for the current children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §747.501(9))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The most recent inspection report was not posted.    This was corrected at inspection with the caregiver posting the inspection report at the conclusion of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The caregiver needed 14 hours of annual training in the required topics.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The CPR portion of the training was online only, and did not included the required hands-on portion of the training by the compliance date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The caregiver did not provide verification that fire drills were completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: The caregiver did not provide complete child admission records for 4 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: The caregiver did not provide verification that the fire extinguisher was mounted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The caregiver did not provide verification of 30 hours of required annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The caregiver's did not provide verification of current CPR and first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: 2 pet dog records were not up to date with vaccinations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: Testing of the smoke detector had not been conducted on a monthly basis.    This was corrected during inspection with a test.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §747.5115)

occurrences.finding: Smoke-Detection System: The smoke detector was not working.    This was corrected during inspection with batteries.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke-Detection System (26 TAC §747.5111)

occurrences.finding: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly: The carbon monoxide detector had not been tested monthly.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electric or Battery Operated CO System-Test Monthly (26 TAC §747.5337(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: The fire extinguisher was not mounted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations: 2 pet dogs did not have documentation of vaccinations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Documentation of Vaccinations (26 TAC §747.3703(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: Monthly fire drills have not been conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §747.5005(1))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers: The caregiver's first aid and CPR training was expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training - Primary, Assistant, and Substitute Caregivers (26 TAC §747.1313(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training: The caregiver did not have 30 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Primary Caregiver -30 Hours Annual Training (26 TAC §747.1303(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 4 children in care did not have complete admission records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation - Use Sanitary Holders: Snacks were observed served directly on a table and not on a plate or napkin.    The provider corrected by placing the snacks on a plate during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation - Use Sanitary Holders (26 TAC §747.3117(5))

occurrences.finding: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report: The most recent inspection was not posted.    The provider posted the inspection during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Posting Requirements-Inspection Report (26 TAC §747.401(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Two children in care do not have the required admission information and related documentation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers: The fire extinguisher was not mounted or located in an easily accessible area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Mounting of Fire Extinguishers (26 TAC §747.5105)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A large tree limb was hanging over the outdoor play area and appears to have the potential to fall while children are outside playing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §747.3501)

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment: The stationary piece of outdoor play equipment did not have the required use zone of 6 feet in all directions.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Stationary Equipment (26 TAC §747.4603)
